Name: Rose's Meat Compatibility Patch
Author: Roseloves109
Description: I created a meat compatibility patch for my mod [i]Rose’s Cruelty Free Meat[/i]. This patch introduces a machine called the [b]Meat Atom Machine[/b], which converts the cruelty-free meats from my mod into meats compatible with the [i]Animal Husbandry Mod[/i]. I’ve also added compatibility for [i]Mizu’s Turkey Mod[/i] and [i]Mizu’s Quail Mod[/i], so your grown meats can now be used with those as well. You unlock the Meat Atom Machine’s crafting recipe at level 1, making it accessible right from the start. This helps integrate cruelty-free gameplay into a wider range of modded experiences. [b]Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
